title: Online Room
summary: In-place C half of the room-metaserver contract: version 2 tickets and replay memory, the metaserver profile store and status calls, the profile store contract with an in-memory store, the client's connection ladder, metaserver entry and account calls, round trip, room close codes, and nt_http transports.
dependencies: features/network-core codec (nt::network_core_codec) for the ticket layout and HMAC
the engine's vendored cJSON for the metaserver's JSON answers
the engine's nt_http for the transport sources the consumer compiles
features/metaserver as the other half of CONTRACT.md
provides: online_room CMake target with PUBLIC ONLINE_ROOM_PLAYERS_MAX, ONLINE_ROOM_PARTING_MAX, ONLINE_ROOM_PROFILE_TEXT_MAX
online_room/profile_store.h and memory_store.h: online_profile_store contract, online_memory_store
online_room/entry.h, meta_entry.h, meta_account.h, rtt.h: the client's ladder, entry, account calls and round trip

flags.runtime: none; sizes come from the consumer's CMake
